messages:
ana: Heads-up: restores failing in staging when using snapshots from last night. Error: KMS DecryptError on snapshot restore. :eyes:

mike: which snapshot id?

ana: snap-2026-03-22-23 (snap-1234). runbook shows it was uploaded by backup-uploader v2 with cmk arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:cmk/old-key

julia: we rotated the uploader IAM role yesterday and removed kms:Decrypt for the uploader service account. Could be grant missing.

ana: but uploader shouldn't need Decrypt to upload; it should just set SSE-KMS header. Logs show `EncryptHeader: cmk=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:cmk/old-key`

mike: timeline: role change at 2026-03-22T21:05 by @elaine

elaine: I changed the role to remove kms:Decrypt on principle of least privilege; I thought it only needed kms:GenerateDataKey*

mike: right — but if the uploader API does an import/encrypt step it may call Decrypt during key wrapping for CMK alias resolution. Can we check uploader logs?

encops-bot: deploy: backup-uploader v2.4 deployed by mike at 2026-03-22T20:58

julia: fetching logs... attaching snippet

```
[2026-03-22T23:01:12Z] upload_start snap-1234 cmk=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:cmk/old-key
[2026-03-22T23:01:13Z] sns=ok s3_put=ok kms_encrypt=ok
[2026-03-22T23:01:14Z] finalize: Attempting kms:Decrypt to verify key alias -> AccessDenied
error: KMS.DecryptDenied
```

ana: so snapshot metadata references old-key that no one can Decrypt -> restore attempts hit AccessDenied

julia: short term: can we add a one-off grant to uploader role to kms:Decrypt on that CMK and run restore?

mike: oncall @tilly-sre can you approve a short-lived grant? Ops prefers ephemeral grants via KMS Grant API.

tilly-sre: oncall: I can create a grant for 1 hour. Need CMK arn and target principal.

ana: CMK arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:cmk/old-key, principal: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/backup-uploader

tilly-sre: creating grant... done. GrantId: g-0a1b2c3d, expires 1h. Try restore now.

ana: restore now succeeds :tada: verifying integrity. Will follow up with fix to uploader to avoid Decrypt call.

elaine: apologies — I'll roll back role change for uploader until fix deployed. Also propose a unit test to catch Decrypt usage during uploads.

julia: open a short-term postmortem? action items: restore runbook, role policy review, uploader fix (remove Decrypt), add CI test, add audit alert when upload uses Decrypt.

ana: noted. I'll file ticket and ping SOC for audit logs correlation. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
